descriptionHtml:
Bug B23 · P1 · known

Patient cards are missing fields: age shows '76y' not '76F', Hospital cards have no hospital day, Nursing Home cards no visit number

Tickets: TFA-92579 AC3–4 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92579): the backend stores sex = F, yet the card shows '76y'; the Nursing Home diagnosis cells of TC-01/S03 and S26 are B28's root cause, so they need no Q4.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-01/S03, TC-01/S05, TC-01/S06, TC-01/S26

Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S07 The day/visit number and the badge roll across a server-day boundary and never freeze

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 The day/visit number advances each calendar day by server time and never stays frozen; a device with a wrong clock or time zone shows the same number. (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 4; UAT 3.8)
  • U4 The card shows the New Admission / Follow-up / Consult badge. (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 3)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given seededCensus H1 (Day 3, New Admission), H2 (Day 6, Consult), H3 (set to New Admission, then changed by hand to Follow-up the same day), N1 (New Admission) and N3 (Consult), list open

When Advance the server clock past the next calendar-day boundary; (a) keep the list open across the roll, (b) close and reopen the app

Then H1 shows Day 4 and H2 Day 7 and the NH numbers move per Q3, in both cases, without re-entering anything; on the card New Admission (H1, N1) and Consult (H2, N3) now show Follow-up; H3, already changed by hand, still shows Follow-up

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-01 'advances each calendar day and must not stay frozen' + AC 4 'server time'; badge rows from UAT TC-06 ('New Admission and Consult both roll to Follow-up on the next calendar day'; 'a status already changed by hand is not affected'). A badge that rolls on the device clock is known: TFA-92584 AC 8. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.
